description: Check one more QKV skip before declaring a local plateau
proposal: Family: parameter tying. Current retained frontier is 1,605 parameters at 99.010000%, a +0.010000-point margin. There have been 59 prior macro-attempts and 527 prior micro-trials in this family. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0160/micro-0012 at 1,605/99.01%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0161/micro-0001, where pair 648/538 scored 98.99% at 1,604. Ten measured sensitive pairs are excluded. Hypothesis: one additional nearest unmeasured pair may reopen the long qualifying bands seen after earlier skips; if the first candidate also fails, two consecutive no-accept macros will define a bounded local plateau. The helper adds one ordered union per official micro-trial with runner-only retention/rollback. Stop at first scored discard/error, no pair, 20 trials, or 25 minutes. This is more informative than an immediate switch because it distinguishes an isolated failure from the predeclared two-failure plateau criterion.
summary: The QKV plateau-check band evaluated seven ordered unions. Six qualified and reduced the frontier from 1,605 to 1,599 parameters; micro-0007 proposed 1,598, failed qualification, and was rolled back. Outcomes: 6 accepts, 1 scored nonqualification, 0 errors. Compute used seven official migrations/verifications over about 8m30s. Stop reason: first scored discard before the 20-trial/25-minute cap; the proposed two-failure plateau was falsified by the first six accepts.
